description:
gf2-core compiles with dead-code warnings under supported partial feature and tuning configurations that the full-feature lint run does not exercise.

## Background

`crates/gf2-core/src/alg/m4rm.rs` defines `choose_k_block`, whose only caller is the test-support entry point `multiply_rowwise_for_test`; a build without `test` or the `test-support` feature, for example with only the `simd` feature, reports it as never used. `crates/gf2-core/src/tuning/baked.rs` defines `SIMD_MIN_WORDS`, which a baked-tuning build reports as never used. The repository lint gate runs with all features, so neither warning reaches it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `gf2-core` builds without dead-code warnings with default features, with only the `simd` feature, and under `--cfg gf2_tuning_baked`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every item removed or re-gated has no remaining caller in any supported configuration, and the tuning values the baked configuration documents stay single-sourced.

## Notes

Surfaced by the polynomial-multiplication baseline survey while building its gf2 arm against `gf2-core` with the `simd` feature only.
title: Remove gf2-core dead code under partial feature configurations
